To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

stromal ZEB-1 expression is required for mammary tumour initiation, growth and metastasis and that stromal Zeb1 deletion in mammary tumours reduces extracellular matrix remodeling and immune cell infiltration, and increases p53 acetylation and recruitment to pro-tumoral gene promoters.
stromal ZEB expression promotes breast tumour progression through a p53-dependent mechanism.
ZEB1 expression in stromals cells promotes tumour growth and progression by activating a p53-dependent transcriptional program.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel cancer therapeutics and the discovery of new biomarkers.
the identification and validation of new targets for breast cancer therapy.
the role of ZEB1 in the stroma and its impact on breast cancer progression.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Zeb1 is a driver of breast cancer and that its expression in stromal fiboblasts is required for tumorigenesis.
Zeb1 in stroma cells is required for mammary tumour formation.
Zeb1 is a master transcription factor that regulates a complex network of signaling pathways in the stroma that are required for tumour growth.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
stromal Zeb1 is a driver of tumour progression.
ZEB1 is a master transcription factor in the stroma that promotes tumour initiation, growth and progression by regulating extracellular matrix remodeling and immune response.
ZEB1 is a transcriptional factor that regulates the production of several pro-tumoural factors in fibroblasts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
stromal cells, and not epithelial cells, are responsible for the expression of this EMT transcription factor.
the ZEB1 transcriptional program in stromal cells regulates the production of pro-tumorigenic cytokines and growth factors.
stromal Zeb1 is a key player in the tumour microenvironment and that it is a druggable target for cancer treatment.
